messages:
maria: Heads-up: customer reported apparent double-charge when a streaming request hit a routing failover mid-toolcall. Not reproducing locally yet. See logs below.

ahmed: can you paste the log snippet? which model / route?

maria: model: rwd-3b-quant, route: us-west-2-low-latency (shard-3 -> shard-7 failover). Log: `2026-03-15T14:03:12Z stream start session=xyz token_seq=0` then `2026-03-15T14:03:13Z route handoff session=xyz from=shard-3 to=shard-7` then `2026-03-15T14:03:13Z toolcall truncated client_eof=true acked=42` and later `2026-03-15T14:03:14Z final-charge computed tokens=120 confirmed=false` and `2026-03-15T14:03:14Z provisional-charge emitted tokens=180`

jules: so provisional != final and both got recorded?

maria: customer's console shows both provisional and final entries, net billed for 180. They expect de-duplication when final settles.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1483 assigned to @ahmed.

ahmed: quick theory: during handoff we create a provisional ledger row at resume start (optimistic), but the handoff caused the shard to truncate the in-flight toolcall and the other shard didn't emit a tombstone to clear provisional. So UI shows both.

sam: do we currently tag ledger rows with route_reason / handoff_id? If not, matching gets hard.

ben: we have `session_id` and `replica_tag` but no durable `handoff_id` header. Matching relies on session+sequence ranges which is broken when truncation resets seq numbers.

maria: telemetry gap: console only shows `provisional` vs `confirmed` as flags, but doesn't expose the route fallback chain. Ops wants to see `route_chain: shard-3->shard-7` and `handoff_id` to reconcile.

jules: proposed fix: 1) add X-Route-Handoff header generated on every routing hop (immutable id). 2) ledger rows include handoff_id and a tombstone pointer when truncated. 3) console UI exposes route_chain and a single-click request for refund calculation.

ahmed: backend caveats: adding header is simple. But we need idempotency: if handoff_id changes across retries we can't dedupe. The handoff id must be preserved across reconnects by the client side-router.

ben: runtime change: when a shard receives a handoff with a `truncated=true` flag we must emit a tombstone event to the ledger to mark prior provisional rows stale. Needs tight ordering to avoid race with confirm path.

sam: meter/metric ask: if we add tombstones, we need a metric `ledger.tombstone_emitted` and dashboard panels showing tombstone-to-provisional ratio and tombstone lag. Ops wants alerts when tombstones > 0.5% of provisionals over 5m for a route.

maria: UX ask: for customer-facing console, show the "billing state timeline" with provisional -> tombstone (optional) -> final. Right now final supersedes provisional but we lack visibility when tombstones are missing.

jules: rollout plan: step A (internal): ship header + tombstone event and keep provisional as-is but mark tombstone in ledger. Step B: console reads tombstones and collapses entries. Step C: automated reclamation that credits customers when tombstone present and final < provisional.

ahmed: timeline: A in canary next week, B after data collection (1 week), C post-approval (safety review). Need owners: runtime (ben), ledger (jules), console (sam), product sign-off (maria).

ben: small implementation note: tombstone events must include last_ack_seq and last_token_count to reconcile partial toolcalls accurately. Example tombstone payload: `{"handoff_id":"h-abc123","last_ack_seq":42,"last_tokens":120}` — but we will store as structured fields in ledger.

sam: console change: add a toggle to show provisional rows. Default keep current collapsed billing so we don't confuse users on day one.

maria: tests: integration with simulated shard handoff + injected `client_eof` should create tombstone and final result with lower tokens. Add e2e that asserts UI shows collapsed single final entry when tombstone exists.

jules: one more gotcha: background embeddings and prefetch can create separate provisional rows with different session ids but share a parent request. We should propagate handoff_id up to parent request to dedupe at invoice level.

ahmed: created GH issue: rwd/infra#4521 with acceptance criteria + test matrix. Linking here.

ben:does anyone object to header name `X-Route-Handoff`?

sam: fine by me. Add `x-route-reason` optional for human-readable fallback reason.

maria: ok let's move forward. Owners, please ack. I'll schedule sync Friday 10am to walk through telemetry dashboards and sample logs.

ahmed: ack (owner).

ben: ack (runtime owner).

jules: ack (ledger owner).

sam: ack (console owner).

maria: thanks — filing action items in INC-2026-1483 and rwd/infra#4521.
